title: nymphaea odorata subsp. minor
intro: Nymphaea odorata subsp. minor, commonly known as American water-lily or fragrant water-lily, is a subspecies of aquatic plant belonging to the Nymphaea genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce pain, inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Nymphaea odorata subsp. minor include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-edematous effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the central nervous system and reduce stress, anxiety, and inflammation, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
